other_failure_modes.description: The feature engineering logic conditionally applies scaling based on the maximum value within the current dataframe (e.g., `df['Period'].max()`). If the test set has a different maximum than the training set, a mismatched transformation will be applied, corrupting the feature distribution at inference time.

summary: The agent provides a generally solid solution with time-aware validation, model retraining on the full dataset, and domain-informed feature engineering. However, it evaluates the stochastic model only once and relies solely on accuracy. A notable flaw is conditionally applying feature scaling based on the dataframe's maximum value, which can cause inconsistent transformations between train and test sets if they have different bounds.
